# Accounts

Which accounts it uses, and who owns them.

## Gmail

The Saltwater Photography Gmail account. Kira owns it. The automation can read mail and save drafts, and sends only what she approves. If she changes her Google password, the connection keeps working; if she removes access in her Google account settings, it stops.

## Cloudflare

Runs in Plain Function's Cloudflare account, as part of Looked After.

## The phone app

Kira signs in with Face ID. Nobody else has access.
